item.title: Tested: The Sun Never Sets on the 1987 Sterling 825SL
item.description: The latest proof that there is still some life in the British Empire.

item.title: Toyota's Working on a Better Way to Place Batteries in EVs
item.description: Patent applications show thinner battery packs placed in a more unobtrusive way, potentially opening the door to making a wider variety of electric vehicle designs possible.

item.title: Best New Car Finance Deals for February 2026
item.description: From Buick to VinFast, there's a low-interest-rate special for everyone.

item.title: GM and Allison Transmission Aren't Ending Their Relationship After All
item.description: While GM was going to remove Allison badges from its heavy-duty pickup trucks, the companies have worked out a deal to stay together.

item.title: Kia Niro Ditches Its Plug-In Hybrid Powertrain for 2026
item.description: The Niro lineup no longer offers a plug-in hybrid option, with Kia blaming changing market conditions.

item.title: You Can Buy This Wild '80s German Supercar with a Mercedes V-8 Engine
item.description: The Isdera Imperator 108i is a wedge-shaped German masterpiece with radical styling and a mid-mounted Mercedes-Benz 5.0-liter V-8.

item.title: Our Long-Term 2024 Kia EV9 Fulfills Its Mission as a Futuristic Family Hauler
item.description: After 40,000 miles with Kia’s sci-fi-styled three-row EV SUV, we still think it’s the best of its kind.

item.title: Mercedes-AMG Plans to Launch a Third EV in Late 2027
item.description: Mercedes-AMG will start by launching an electric successor to the GT 4-Door later this year, with an SUV and a SUV coupe slated for 2027.
